license.ruleChangeHint: A pricing rule change only applies from the next paid period — the period you already paid for keeps the old rules.
license.historyText: The rule changed a few times over time: first by user count, then by role and rights, then by "paid rights". Each change applied only from its effective date, never retroactively — we follow the same principle: solo master — 5,000 AMD, salon master — 4,000 AMD, first admin free, next admins — 2,000 AMD each (see "How the fee is calculated" above). If the pricing rule changes, it will only affect your next paid period.
